analysis: The method getLastChildInternal is recursive. It first checks if node.getChildCount() == 0, and if so, returns the node itself. Otherwise, it calls node.getLastChild() and recursively calls itself on that child. The API documentation for getLastChild states that it throws NoSuchElementException if the node has no children. In this code, getLastChild is only called after confirming that getChildCount() is not zero, so the condition for NoSuchElementException is avoided. Therefore, NoSuchElementException is fully avoided.
remark: Since NoSuchElementException is avoided by the prior check on child count, no exceptions remain unhandled. The recursive call will continue until a node with no children is reached, but that case returns early without calling getLastChild. Thus, no exceptions are thrown.
